description: Department of  Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 993 - Order made to direct that a duty be Levied on bottled today w.e.f. 01.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette content is a notification issued under the Excise Ordinance, specifically Excise Notification No. 993. It introduces a new duty on bottled toddy and rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory change and falls under the category of "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" (Type 5), which includes "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation." While a minister is named, the primary purpose is to announce a regulatory change, not a personnel appointment or government restructuring.
